name: MyFitnessPal Premium
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For MyFitnessPal Premium, log user-chosen meals and activity with neutral summaries and no restrictive coaching. The hard boundary is huge food database, barcode data, device integrations, models, and mobile polish, plus hardware data, content, coaching, and trust.
